rule: Every createAdminClient() call in src/ is trusted with every shelter, so each is either needs-shelter-filter (tenant data a Lanna admin or another shelter must not reach) or cross-shelter with its reason. unclassified names a site that cannot be decided from the code; the check tolerates and lists it. scripts/check-service-role-sites.mjs fails on any call not recorded here. Part 7 of #ykefa, item #ps6ms; docs/decisions/2026-11-17-service-role-sites-audit.md.

sites.reason: Changes the signed-in person's own password by their own auth user id. An auth-account operation on the one row the session already names, not a read of tenant data.

listAllUsers() lists every auth account to name who made each change. With several shelters on one project a Lanna admin sees every shelter's users here (audit_log itself is read through the user's own client, so RLS governs that half). Spike-named site.
Opens two-step setup for a user id taken from the request; must be limited to users of the acting admin's shelter.
Reads roles by key to decide whether a role may be given; role keys are unique per shelter only, so the read must carry the shelter.
Creates an auth user and its role row; the new login must be created inside the acting admin's shelter.
Writes a name on an auth user id from the request; must refuse a user of another shelter.
Approves an access request and creates the login; request and new user must both belong to the acting admin's shelter.
Changes the main role of a user id from the request; target user and role must both be in the acting shelter.
Adds a user_roles row for a user and role from the request; both must be in the acting shelter.
Deletes a user_roles row; must be limited to the acting shelter's users and roles.
Reads the doctor row linked to a login; doctors are shelter data.
Clears doctors.user_id for a doctor id from the request; must refuse another shelter's doctor.
Sets a password on an auth user id from the request; must refuse a user of another shelter.
Archives a user's user_roles rows and bans the login; target must be in the acting shelter.
Restores a user's user_roles rows; target must be in the acting shelter.
Deletes an auth user; target must be in the acting shelter (the most destructive site in the file).
Dismisses an access request and archives its user_roles; request must be in the acting shelter.
